QUALITY_HINTS.PENDING: The audio is being analyzed before prediction.
QUALITY_HINTS.READY: The recording looks clean enough to analyze.
QUALITY_HINTS.FIX: Try re-recording closer to the microphone, reducing silence, or lowering background noise.

QUALITY_ISSUES.TOO_SHORT_MSG: The clip is shorter than 1.5 seconds, so the model has very little speech context.
QUALITY_ISSUES.SHORT_MSG: The clip is a bit short for stable emotion recognition.
QUALITY_ISSUES.LOW_SIGNAL_MSG: The waveform energy is extremely low, which often means silence or a distant microphone.
QUALITY_ISSUES.QUIET_MSG: The speech signal is present but weak.
QUALITY_ISSUES.SILENCE_MSG: Large parts of the clip are silent, which reduces the amount of analyzable speech.
QUALITY_ISSUES.CLIPPING_MSG: Some samples are near the maximum amplitude, suggesting distorted audio.
QUALITY_ISSUES.MILD_CLIPPING_MSG: A small portion of the waveform reaches near-full scale.
QUALITY_ISSUES.WEAK_PEAKS_MSG: The waveform peak is low, so the recording may sound far away or muted.
QUALITY_ISSUES.CLEAN_MSG: No major issue detected before prediction.

QUALITY_SUGGESTIONS.RECORD_LONGER: Record at least 2 to 3 seconds of spoken speech.
QUALITY_SUGGESTIONS.EXTEND_UTTERANCE: Extend the utterance slightly so the model hears more prosody.
QUALITY_SUGGESTIONS.SPEAK_LOUDER: Move closer to the microphone and speak a bit louder.
QUALITY_SUGGESTIONS.INCREASE_GAIN: Increase voice level or microphone gain.
QUALITY_SUGGESTIONS.TRIM_PAUSES: Trim long pauses or record a more continuous utterance.
QUALITY_SUGGESTIONS.REDUCE_GAIN: Reduce input gain or move the microphone farther away.
QUALITY_SUGGESTIONS.AVOID_LOUD: Avoid speaking too loudly into the mic.
QUALITY_SUGGESTIONS.MIC_CLOSER: Keep the microphone closer to your mouth.
QUALITY_SUGGESTIONS.READY: The signal looks balanced and ready for prediction.
